decisions.reason: As a close-to-core classic door lever handle, it strengthens the firm's broad architectural hardware range and there is no sign after launch that it should be withdrawn so quickly.
A door lever handle family fits the firm's strategy of offering system breadth across building types and price levels, so keeping it supports specification and cross-selling.
This door handle design matches the firm's design-led positioning and certified fittings business, making continued market presence the likely choice in 2019.
Because the firm competes on design quality and portfolio depth, retaining another close-to-core door handle design is consistent with how a large German fittings supplier would manage its range.
Keeping this door lever handle family helps cover more aesthetic and project requirements within the established offer, which suits the firm's broad-market approach.

The electronic access system aligns especially well with the firm's move toward digital building organization and was presented as technically distinctive, so management would be inclined to continue it.
